data.define: Used to react when something is awkward, embarrassing or a bad idea.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host 'big yikes' about dinner.

native.tip: “big yikes” = qué vergüenza. Ejemplo: “Socks with sandals? Big yikes.”
native.caption:
¿Qué significa “big yikes”?
“big yikes” = qué vergüenza.
Ejemplo: “Socks with sandals? Big yikes.” (¿Calcetines con sandalias? "big yikes".)
